@RepMGP @repmgp is NOT advocating for more ‘programs’

Correctional officers face brutal realities—exposure to violence, PTSD rates surpassing combat veterans, and systemic neglect. But pumping more taxpayer dollars into "mental health resources" without auditing existing programs is a recipe for waste. The Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration (SAMHSA) already burns through $7.5B annually, yet frontline officers still lack trauma-informed care.

Instead of expanding bloated bureaucracies, redirect funds from failed initiatives like $50M telemedicine grants that prioritize consulting firms over direct care. Secure prisons first—overcrowding and understaffing fuel the crisis.

Fix the root: slash administrative bloat, mandate accountability for existing mental health budgets, and prioritize officer safety over performative spending. Real solutions demand efficiency, not just more spending.
